data.name: CsoPreviewBlocking
data.value: The Sync Preview found something that would stop the synchronization; see the details below.

data.name: CsoListPageInfo
data.value: The Connector Space holds this Connected System's Connected System Objects. Inbound changes from the system are held here before being committed to the Metaverse. Outbound changes are held here ahead of synchronization to the Connected System.

data.name: CsoListClearExplain2
data.value: Run a Full Import to rebuild the Connector Space. At the first Full Synchronization after that import completes successfully, Metaverse values contributed by objects that did not return are recalled automatically. Each Metaverse object's type Deletion Rule is then applied for objects that did not return, with its configured grace period.

data.name: CsoListClearExplain3
data.value: Note: A Full Synchronization run before then does nothing beyond ordinary synchronization. The reconciliation refuses, leaving everything as it was, if far fewer objects return than were cleared; re-import the rest, or raise the allowed share in Service Settings, then run a Full Synchronization again.

data.name: PexExplainNotInSystem
data.value: The referenced object has no Connected System Object in this Connected System. It is out of scope for every Synchronization Rule into this system, or has not been provisioned. The reference cannot be written until it is.

data.name: PexListPageInfo
data.value: Pending Exports are changes that need to be applied to the Connected System. These are created when Metaverse Objects change and need to be synchronized to this target system.
